event.title: A Convoy
event.text:
A transmission from The Colony Ship reaches you as your squad crosses into another people's space.
"We can't jump to another galaxy. Nobody can. But we could fly there, the long way, if we don't fly alone. It will take generations. No single people has everything a voyage like that needs, but all of us together might. Ask every people we know of to join the convoy. All of them. Start with the ones who have already lost their homes."

choice.text: We'll ask them.

outcome.text: Your squad carries a new offer with it: a place in the convoy for every people that will fly beside the others, and give the voyage what they have.

event.title: The Azurethea and the Convoy
event.text:
An Azurethea elder listens to the offer without interrupting, wings folded, then answers softly.
"A voyage longer than any of our lives. You are asking us to leave our home, and trust strangers to fly beside us the whole way."

choice.text: Offer their people passage in the convoy.

outcome.text: "We have already learned to leave," the elder says. "We would rather leave together." The Azurethea pledge to the convoy. Wherever they fly in it, there will be air.

choice.text: Show them how many peoples already fly together.

outcome.text: The elder looks over the list of peoples for a long time. "Then they are not strangers," they say at last. The Azurethea pledge to the convoy. Wherever they fly in it, there will be air.

choice.text: Let {crew} tell them the Tentauri will shield them.

outcome.text: {crew} speaks quietly of the Tentauri shields already wrapped around the convoy. The elder lowers their wings. The Azurethea pledge to the convoy. Wherever they fly in it, there will be air.

choice.text: Let {crew} promise to keep their people's records.

outcome.text: "We, The Senti-, will keep the name of every Azurethea aboard, however long the voyage." The elder is silent for a long moment, then agrees. The Azurethea pledge to the convoy. Wherever they fly in it, there will be air.

choice.text: Leave them be.

event.title: The Tentauri and the Convoy
event.text: Two Tentauri answer your hail, their voices in step. "A convoy. Many ships, flying as one, for longer than any of us will live. Show us that you can fly as one."

choice.text: Fly a joint operation with them.

outcome.text: You cross the cluster beside them, your shields overlapping theirs. At the far side the two voices answer together: the Tentauri pledge to the convoy, and their shields with it.
Raiders find you halfway across. The Tentauri hold their place beside you, and before the shooting starts they say it plainly: they will fly with the convoy, and their shields with it.

choice.text: Show them the convoy already flies as one.

outcome.text: The two Tentauri are quiet while they count the ships. "As one," they say together. The Tentauri pledge to the convoy, and their shields with it.

choice.text: Let {crew} speak for the Azurethea in the convoy.

outcome.text: {crew} tells them how gently the Azurethea fly, and how many of them the convoy already carries. The Tentauri pledge to it, and their shields with it.

choice.text: Leave them be.

event.title: The Mecha and the Convoy
event.text: A Mecha yard boss hears the offer out, then laughs. "A voyage that takes generations. Every ship in it wearing out, breaking down, needing parts. And what do the Mecha get out of it?"

choice.text: Pay them to join.

outcome.text: "Now it's a contract." The Mecha pledge to the convoy. Their yards will keep it flying, for as long as it pays.

choice.text: Let {crew} show them the numbers.

outcome.text: {crew} lays it out in clipped Mecha code: every people in the convoy, every ship wearing out for generations, and only one yard to fix them all. The yard boss runs the numbers twice and grins. The Mecha pledge to the convoy. Their yards will keep it flying, for as long as it pays.

choice.text: Walk away.

event.title: The Mecha and the Convoy
event.text:
A Mecha yard boss doesn't let you finish. "Leave? We're winning here. Ask us again when we're not."
The yard boss looks your squad over, interested. "But if you came all this way for something, we could make it a contest."

choice.text: Accept the contest.

outcome.text: "Good!" Their frames drop out of the yard, already firing.

event.title: The Senti and the Convoy
event.text: A Senti archive station hails you, its light lines bright. "We, The Senti-, have recorded your offer. A voyage of many generations is a long time to remember the way."

choice.text: Offer them the convoy's records to keep.

outcome.text: "Every people in it, kept. Every chart, every name. We, The Senti-, will fly with the convoy." The Senti pledge to it, and their memory with it.

choice.text: Pay to shield their archive ship.

outcome.text: "Our records first. Then the voyage." The Senti pledge to the convoy, and their memory with it.

choice.text: Let {crew} link with the station.

outcome.text: {crew} exchanges a single burst of data with the station, and the station sends its charts back to your ships. "I told them what the convoy is," {crew} says. The Senti pledge to it, and their memory with it.

choice.text: Not now.

event.title: The Senti and the Convoy
event.text:
The Senti here are doomed, and they know it. Their ships turn toward yours before you finish the offer. They mean to keep your records. They have no use for your crew.
Somewhere behind them is the archive that could still answer.

choice.text: Fight through to the archive.

outcome.text: The Senti ships close in, their beams already warm.

choice.text: Jump away.

event.title: The Archive
event.text:
Past the wreckage, the Senti archive hails you at last.
"We, The Senti-, will join your convoy. We will keep all of it: every record aboard your ships, every chart, and the biological data of every one of your crew. All of it, or nothing."

choice.text: Let them record everything, biological data included.

outcome.text: Your Armoured Avatar Array opens to them. For a long moment every system in your squad flickers while they copy everything you are. Then a single word: "Kept." The Senti pledge their archive to the convoy, and their memory with it.

event.title: The Lykario and the Convoy
event.text: A Lykario packleader laughs at the offer. "Ride in a convoy for generations, like prey in a pen? No. But a convoy that long draws prey, and somebody has to hunt for it. Show us you're worth hunting beside."

choice.text: Accept a fair hunt against them.

outcome.text: "Good!" The pack comes for you, and it is not playing. Win, and they'll hunt for the convoy.

choice.text: Let {crew} vouch for your squad.

outcome.text: {crew} tells the story of your last fight, with a few details improved. The pack is restless enough to listen, and the packleader grins. The Lykario pledge to hunt for the convoy. Nothing alive will reach it without the pack sensing it first.

choice.text: Let {crew} offer them a contract.

outcome.text: {crew} talks pay, GATOS style: so much a jump for every raider the pack runs off. The Lykario take the first payment and pledge to hunt for the convoy. Nothing alive will reach it without the pack sensing it first.

choice.text: Move on.

event.title: The Malphen and the Convoy
event.text: A Malphen ship drifts across your path, silent and swollen. It does not answer hails. It never will: the Malphen do not speak. Whatever reaches them has to reach them as scent, or as something living.

choice.text: Reach it through the gland, and offer it matter.

outcome.text: Your gland breathes a scent into the space between your ships, and you dump matter after it. The ship gathers every scrap, slowly. Then it turns and falls in behind your squad. It will follow the convoy, feed on its waste and wrecks, and grow back the matter the voyage burns. That is as close to a pledge as the Malphen ever come.

choice.text: Reach it through the gland, and promise it the convoy's waste.

outcome.text: Your gland breathes a scent of a long line of ships, and of everything they will leave behind. The Malphen ship stirs, turns and falls in behind your squad. It will follow the convoy, feed on its waste and wrecks, and grow back the matter the voyage burns. That is as close to a pledge as the Malphen ever come.

choice.text: Leave it.

event.title: The GATOS and the Convoy
event.text:
A GATOS hub answers your hail.
"The convoy? The Colony Ship is GATOS. We signed before anyone. Our cores will keep it powered, however many generations it takes."

event.title: The Metastasis
event.text:
The rim is here, and the whole convoy is behind you: every people you know of, flying as one.
Then something vast and living uncoils across the way out. A Malphen growth that answers to no scent and no pledge, swollen on everything the collapse left behind. It sees a long line of ships full of life, and it comes to feed.
The other races have a name for a growth like that. They call it the Metastasis.

choice.text: Close ranks around The Colony Ship.

outcome.text: The convoy draws in tight. Your allies' weapons come online beside yours.

choice.text: Strike first, ahead of the convoy.

outcome.text: Your squad charges ahead alone. You'll hit it before it's ready, but your allies are a long way behind you.

choice.text: Turn its own hunger against it.

outcome.text: Your gland breathes a scent of easier prey across the way out, pointed somewhere else. Part of the growth tears loose and chases it into the dark.
